newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Chronology of Dutch air crashes.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of Dutch air crashes.

text.p: At least 13 people were killed on Wednesday when a Dutch-operated DC-3 Dakota plane plunged into the North Sea near Den Helder in northern Netherlands.
Following is a chronology of air crashes in the Netherlands.
July 1996 - A Belgian Hercules C-130 transport plane crashed near Eindhoven, south Netherlands, killing 34.
April 1994 - A KLM-Cityhopper plane went down near Amsterdam's Schiphol Airport, killing three and injuring 21.
September 1992 - Four killed when a light aircraft crashed in the northern Netherlands.
October 1992 - Boeing 747 El-Al jet crashed into a block of flats in a southeast suburb of Amsterdam. At least 43 died.
May 1990 - An aviation school plane went down in the northern Netherlands, killing three.
1982 - Fokker F-28 went down at Moerdijk in the central Netherlands, killing 21.
1974 - KLM helicopter crashes in North Sea, six dead.
1954 - KLM DC6 plunges into North Sea, 21 dead.
1950 - KLM DC3 crashes in North Sea, six dead.
1938 - KLM DC3 crashes at Schiphol Airport, six dead.
1935 - KLM Fokker F-22 crashes at Schiphol, six dead.
